# Hype On Media

> Hype On Media is a YouTube growth agency based in Dubai, UAE. We turn underperforming YouTube channels into growth engines using strategy, production, and proprietary analytics built from a decade of scaling 50+ channels across 15 languages to over 5 billion views.

## Services

- [YouTube Performance](https://hypeon.media/#services): Channel strategy, format development, thumbnail and packaging systems, multi-market expansion, performance operations, and analytics frameworks. Our core service.
- [Creative Strategy](https://hypeon.media/#services): Performance creative for DTC and B2B brands. Audience research, barrier mapping, script production, and testing frameworks.
- [Digital Products](https://hypeon.media/#services): AI-powered tools and automation for content operations.

## Free Tools

- [YouTube Channel Audit](https://hypeon.media/analyze): Free channel performance audit. Submit a YouTube channel URL and receive a detailed report covering content, thumbnails, titles, audience signals, and revenue opportunities within 48 hours.

## Content

- [Blog](https://hypeon.media/blog): Articles on YouTube strategy, platform updates, creator economics, and production methodology.

## Company Facts

- Headquarters: Dubai, UAE
- Founded: 2015
- Track record: 50+ channels, 15 languages, 5 billion+ views
- Languages: English, Spanish, French, Russian (native fluency)
- Operations history across 6 countries
- AI-assisted production since 2022
